name: 07-10-vnpay-card-channel
title: Clarify card payment and allow VNPAY card-channel testing
description: Make the POS card action explicit as an at-counter card payment and allow the shared VNPAY provider to select a configured payment channel such as VNBANK for sandbox card testing.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Use the existing provider boundary; no schema or new mutation is required because all VNPAY callers already route through createVnpayPayment.
